_source: Paraphrased from Silas S. Brown, 'Eating at other Cambridge colleges', https://ssb22.user.srcf.net/buttery.html (personal visits; rules may have changed).

Gonville & Caius College.note: a college member has to book for you

Churchill College.note: welcome, non-member prices shown, cards accepted

Clare College.note: about 32% extra; since 2024 you may need to be with a Clare member

Corpus Christi College.note: college members and their guests only

Darwin College.note: about 30% extra, but you need to be with a Darwin member

St John's College.note: non-member prices shown, but you need to be with a St John's member

King's College.note: college members and their guests only

Magdalene College.note: college members only (card reader at the door)

Pembroke College.note: about 67% extra, and you need to be with a Pembroke member

Peterhouse.note: welcome in term time, about 56% extra

Robinson College.note: welcome, non-member prices shown, cards accepted

Selwyn College.note: welcome, prices as marked, card only

Trinity College.note: non-member prices shown, but you need to be with a Trinity member
